items.wrong: We was dancing when you called.

items.why: In questions, were goes before you.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: I sleeping when the music started. → I was sleeping when the music started. | We was dancing when you called. → We were dancing when you came. | What you were doing? → What were you doing?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: I sleeping when the music started.
errors.r: I was sleeping when the music started.

errors.w: We was dancing when you called.
errors.r: We were dancing when you came.

facts.label: Passado contínuo com when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a curta: I was sleeping when the music started.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para dizer o que estava acontecendo: I was sleeping. We were dancing. Use was com I, he, she e it. Use were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para ligar a ação longa com a ação curta: I was sleeping when the music started. A ação longa fica no past progressive e a curta no passado simples: started, called, came.

items.s: We say I sleeping when the music started.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

pages.title: An apartment building · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in an apartment building in Victoria. The hall is quiet and bright. Bia opens her door and sees paper cups on the floor. Her neighbor Nate comes out with a bag. He had a party last night. He wants to say sorry.
“Hi, Bia! Sorry about the party last night. Was it loud?” says Nate. “Yes! I was sleeping when the music started.” says Bia. “Oh no. What time was it?” says Nate.
